title: Knobby Golden French Mushroom Gratin
description: A rich and creamy French dish featuring saffron and ferment jang, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This ovo-vegetarian friendly recipe is a twist on traditional Normandy cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Butter a 9x13 inch baking dish and set aside.
In a large skillet, saute the onions and garlic until softened.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Stir in the saffron threads and ferment jang, cooking for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, whisk together the heavy cream, gruyere cheese, eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked mushroom mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 35 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the gratin is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
